1) the reflectance effects can be eliminated from color images by thresholding the logarithmic gradient of the luminance image at locations of abrupt color change, 2) the gradient field at thresholded locations can be improved by a curl-correction technique, and 3) the resulting Poisson equation for the shading field can be solved directly by the fast Fourier transform method.
